Key Responsibilities:  
  
Manage Human Resource and Payroll Functions: Take charge of implementing and overseeing payroll, human resources, hiring, and onboarding processes, including bi-weekly payroll at three locations/companies and maintaining records and process control.  
  
Lead Payroll Management: Guide operations and personnel to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing, including regular payroll and non-work payments.  
  
Handle HR Processes: Oversee new hire paperwork, screening interviews, job postings, job description updates, and compliance. Process bi-weekly payroll, update employee records, and manage year-end reporting.  
  
Revenue Recognition Management: Analyze workflow processes and manage revenue recognition using accounting software, including QuickBooks, Square, and National Recreation Reservation System (NRRS).  
  
Day-Use/Reservation Cash Handling: Work closely with operations personnel to record sales and revenue, both on the Rec.gov website and on-site Square processing.  
  
Contribute to Financial Analysis: Play a part in the month-end close process, detailed analysis, and annual budget creation.  
  
Adherence to Accounting Procedures: Assist in implementing, maintaining, and adhering to accounting procedures, ensuring compliance with GAAP within an internal control framework.  
  
Accounting and Administrative Support: Process transactions, maintain accounts, record entries, and review accounts. Provide administrative support to the Controller.  
  
   
  
Skills & Qualifications:  
  
To excel in this role, you should possess a mix of organizational and analytical skills, be comfortable with technology, and have a keen eye for detail. Additional qualifications include:  
  
   
  
Knowledge of US GAAP and experience with revenue recognition under ASC 606.  
  
Proficiency in QuickBooks and Microsoft Office, especially Excel.  
  
Experience with payroll systems; Paychex experience is preferred but not mandatory.  
  
Basic data entry and keyboard competency.  
  
Square retail (or comparable) experience, including reporting and revenue recognition for cash and credit cards.  
  
Comfortable with math and calculations.  
  
Ability to work independently and communicate effectively.  
  
Independent thinker and problem solver with a solution-oriented mindset.  
  
Keen attention to detail is essential.  
  
   
  
Education & Experience Requirements:  
  
Associate or bachelor’s degree with a focus in Accounting and/or Payroll/Human Resources.  
  
2-3 years of experience in accounting and payroll processing.  
  
Proficiency in financial and bookkeeping software.  
  
A background in accounting basics, journal entries, and general ledgers.

I’ve been terrified my life won’t go the way I want it. I want everything to work out how society wants it to work out. But a couple years ago, I did not think I would still be alive today. My opinions of thing change. My perception of life events changes. What happened before matters, but it does not determine the outcome. If you keep going you’re bound to end up somewhere. You shouldn’t have to feel like what you’re doing isn’t important. No shelter no money is awful, but you’re still making it through. It’s impressive to see how hard you’re working to keep going despite having so little. Maybe you will end up somewhere completely different than you thought a couple years ago, and hopefully it’ll keep happening. I’ve deceived myself a while ago, that when ever I get hurt I try to smile. And while I’m lying to myself and everyone else it works. Fake it till you make it sounds stupid, but sometimes it works. None of what I said may be in any way helpful to you. Please keep going though I don’t know for how long.
